label: Tap Processing
info:
Every card tap: arrival, LATE arrival, departure or repeat.

School hours live in school-calendar.json, not here, so both tabs agree.
Credentials live on this tab -> Environment.

label: Roll Call
info:
Time-driven checks.

  MORNING  at classStart + graceSeconds  -> who never arrived?
  END OF DAY at classEnd + checkoutGraceSeconds -> who never left?

Both deadlines come from school-calendar.json. Set graceSeconds to 10 for a live demo and the checks follow automatically.

name: 1 - Student roster
info:
students.json must sit in the Node-RED user directory. Set the FULL path on the file node. Click the inject after editing it - no restart needed.

The roster is published to GLOBAL context so the Roll Call tab can read it too.

name: 2 - A tap arrives
info:
ESP32 publishes {"device":"gate-01","uid":"B96DF306","timestamp":"..."} to school/attendance/scan.

HTTP fallback: POST the same JSON to http://192.168.137.1:1880/attendance

3 - Log it
info:
Create attendance/attendance.csv ONCE with this header:
Date,Time,StudentID,Name,Class,UID,Device,Direction,Status

Direction is IN or OUT. Status is ON_TIME, LATE or OUT.
The Roll Call tab reads these columns, so they must be present.

info:
Every tap gets a reply so the LCD can show a verdict and the buzzer can play a matching pattern.

status values: in_ontime | in_late | out | duplicate | unknown

1 - School calendar & hours
info:
school-calendar.json holds classStart, graceSeconds, classEnd, checkoutGraceSeconds, school days, holidays and excused students.

BOTH tabs read it, so the school day is defined in one place.
Edit the file, click this inject. No restart.

name: 2 - The clock
info:
Ticks every 5 s and fires each check ONCE per day, the moment its deadline passes.

A ticker rather than a cron, because the deadlines are computed from school-calendar.json. Change graceSeconds to 10 for a demo and the morning check follows automatically.

3 - Notify
info:
NOTIFY_PARENTS and NOTIFY_NOT_CHECKED_OUT both start at "false".
The office still gets its summary. Watch it for a few real days, then switch them on.

summary for the office
7 - DEMO RESET (erases today)
info:
Wipes attendance.csv and clears today's per-student state so a rehearsal starts clean.

Why you need it: the roll call counts every row in the CSV dated today. Two demo runs in one afternoon and the second summary still includes the first run's taps - the numbers look wrong when they are actually right.

DO NOT press this on a real school day.

name: clear state + CSV header
8 - Collect parent chat IDs
info:
Give each parent the bot link (t.me/yourbotname). They press START and send any message - 'hi' is enough.

Then press the button here and their name and chat id appear in the debug sidebar, ready to paste into students.json.

Telegram only holds unread messages for 24 hours, so collect on the day. Ids already seen are remembered, so pressing twice still shows everyone.
